name: The Sound
frame: map metres, x east, y north, origin SW corner; yaw clockwise from north; hx along the pad's local x

sites.name: Sound Gate: south headland keep
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: no pad of the new kit exists; the south headland has only a 21 m shelf beside the ring islet at the mouth, which takes a 40 x 40 m keep (a sea work: may stand at the water's edge)
sites.stake: NEW build 2 of 2 (the Sound fortress kit): a sea gate across the Sound mouth between two headland gun keeps seals the Sound, the west's only sheltered anchorage. The site is the south headland keep; the gate spans the mouth. Blowing the gate opens the Sound to Republic boats

sites.name: Sound Gate: north headland keep
sites.size_note: ASSUMED, as the south keep, on the north headland point
sites.stake: NEW build 2 of 2 (the Sound fortress kit): a sea gate across the Sound mouth between two headland gun keeps seals the Sound, the west's only sheltered anchorage. The site is the south headland keep; the gate spans the mouth. Blowing the gate opens the Sound to Republic boats

sites.name: South Notch Keep
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: keep and wall across the gully, 80 x 110 m
sites.stake: A keep and wall from the same Sound fortress kit plug the south-east cliff gully: the main way into the island

sites.name: West Notch Keep
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 70 x 90 m
sites.stake: A second keep and wall from the Sound fortress kit plug the west-coast gully: another way in. Its recon is from the sea

sites.name: Summit AA
sites.comp: CIS Heavy AD Tower with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Flower Tower (1-11)
sites.stake: The highest AA in the west; taking it opens the Sound's sky to LAATs

sites.name: Cliff Galleries
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: tunnel mouth pad 60 x 50 m on the cliff top
sites.stake: Tunnel shells in the north cliff of the Sound (tunnel 1 of 2); taking them takes the wall's north headland from behind

sites.name: Terrace Farms Post
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 60 x 60 m
sites.stake: Stepped fields with low walls; taking it opens the south-west slopes to the West Notch

sites.name: South Cape Landers
sites.stake: CIS landers on the south cape face Black Strand; taking them opens the cape beach (the FOB fallback)

sites.name: Notch Road Checkpoint
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Double Checkpoint (2-07)
sites.stake: Holds the road from the South Notch inland

sites.name: Shoal Pillboxes
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 40 x 24 m on the tephra bank
sites.stake: Pillboxes on a tephra bank in the Pumice Shoals channel fire on boats crossing to Ash Crescent
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Shoal Wreck Fort
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 80 x 80 m on the bar
sites.stake: A wrecked CIS lander on the bar, garrisoned; boats crossing the shoals pass under its guns
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Peak Relay Dish
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: twice the CIS Comms Array's short side
sites.stake: Links the Sound to the caldera; a foot path climbs the summit spire. Taking it cuts the walls' warning to the Yard

sites.name: Sound Rim Guns
sites.comp: CIS AAT Turbolaster Base with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 90 x 90 m
sites.stake: Guns on the north rim cover the inlet; air softens them

sites.name: North Cove Outpost
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 60 x 60 m
sites.stake: Watches the north cove, the back door; taking it opens a second landing beach for the Sound Head assault

sites.name: West Cliff Battery
sites.comp: CIS Small Artillery Base with GPs
sites.size_note: KNOWN: 1-M3
sites.stake: Guns on the west cliffs cover the open sea and the West Notch's approach

sites.name: Ridge Stair Tower
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 30 x 30 m
sites.stake: Holds the stair from the east beach up the cliff; taking it opens the east beach as a way onto the island

sites.name: Sound Fuel Depot
sites.size_note: KNOWN: 1-12
sites.stake: Fuel for the boats; it burns when hit
sites.entrance_note: faces the road that serves it

sites.name: Inland Ramp Depot
sites.comp: CIS Elevated Ramp Depot with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Elevated Landing Pad Construction (2-01)
sites.stake: Holds the Summit AA's ammunition; taking it opens the inland road to the summit

sites.name: Ash Middle Comms
sites.stake: A comms relay on Ash Crescent's crest above the shoals; taking it gives the first look into the lagoon (intel on the Yard)
sites.entrance_note: faces the road that serves it

sites.name: Ash South Gun Line
sites.size_note: KNOWN: 2-09
sites.stake: Guns on Ash's south crest cover the Pumice Shoals channel; silencing them makes the boat crossing to Ash safe

3-F Sound Gate: by boat to the beach just east of the mouth (x 4140-4240, y 10840-10850) or onto the south keep's own shelf beside the ring islet
from the north cove beach along the north shore shelf to the north keep (3-F-N), then the gate's north end
3-M1 South Notch Keep: from the beach at x 3310-3430, y 7525-7565 (shore list), north along the coast and up the gully into the keep's wall
down the Notch road from the plateau (3-04 Notch Road Checkpoint), on the road net, with vehicles
3-M2 West Notch Keep: from the west-coast beach at x 510, y 10675-10730 (shore list), south along the coast and up the gully
on foot from the plateau: Terrace Farms Post (3-02) down the west slope to the keep's back
3-M3 Sound Head: by boat into the Sound to the town quay (under the gate's guns until 3-F falls)
on foot down the crater stair from the plateau road (see foot links)
3-M4 Summit AA: by road from the Inland Ramp Depot (3-14) and the Peak Relay Dish (3-08)
by road from the Sound Fuel Depot (3-13)
